reviews.text: Excellent pet care facility in the heart of Helsinki! My poodle was always very happy there. Highly recommend.

Excellent service and very friendly staff, they are professionals and have high morale, their service and professionalism are perfect🙏 I highly recommend them to anyone who needs their service and dog park, thank you so much, I really appreciate it ❤️🙏 …
Awesome team. They took great care of my dog for many sessions. I have nothing but good words for them. My dog loved his time there and really learned to play with other dogs

We’ve had our puppy at Koiraparkki for two years now and he’s grown to be the most welladjusted teenager, and a lot of that has been the care and stimulus from Koiraparkki. We truly appreciate youse. Pacho loves being at the day care.

The dog park has saved our everyday life! When a dog suffers from separation anxiety and doesn't feel comfortable being alone during the day, it's so wonderful to know that we can take him to a place with the most wonderful staff in the world, and where the dog goes every time with the same excitement! :) <3
Our 5-month-old puppy got an excellent daycare for a city day. The daycare was successful even on a short schedule, thanks to Raisa and partners.

Koiraparkki is a gem. My mixed breed rescue was new to city life and extremely anxious of everything about city life from the people to the busses and trams, she would be shaking on our first few walks. She is a high energy but quite timid girl. Right away I looked for help getting her to feel comfortable before there could be any kind of negative incident. Koiraparkki has been a second home for her. The staff are amazing, really attentive and kind. The owner and staff are knowledgeable and give such good advice. Galaxy has adjusted so well she rides the trams and busses without hesitation and walks confidently around town where she used to tuck her tail and refuse. She perks up when she's on the way to see her doggie friends and always stays at the hotel or with staff when we're out of town. Absolutely the best Helsinki find for dog parents!

Absolutely wonderful service, and Freja is always happy to go ("4w" pulling kind :D) I also really appreciated the short Tiktoks and debriefs one gets, to see that she is loving it (Freja is still a puppy). I have tried both the city center one and Espoo one, and both are great! Pics: 1st: excited to go to daycare, 2nd: soooo tired on the way home to Turku (blurry as I'm about to drive)
Our dog loves coming here during the day! 🐾 …
